title: Is it already decided?
blurb: Nothing has been chosen yet in any of these situations. That does not mean anything is still possible — in Paxos the outcome can be sealed long before anyone could know it. Which of these values could still end up being chosen?

justification.text: No — and this is the point. Alice can never be chosen now, in any continuation whatsoever, even though nothing has been chosen yet and no acceptor could tell you so. Every majority a future proposer could gather would report Bob as the highest vote it has seen, which forces that proposer to propose Bob rather than Alice. The outcome was sealed before anyone could observe it.
Yes. Bob can still end up being chosen — it takes 1 more step from here, and nothing in the situation rules it out.
